Daughter of Manoj Tiwari Allegedly Abuses Cleric, Sparks Online Backlash

Reeti, daughter of Manoj Tiwari, allegedly engaged in a verbal dispute with cleric Qazi Tauqeer, during which she reportedly used abusive language. This incident has led to Qazi Tauqeer becoming agitated and has drawn criticism from social media users, with some users calling for Manoj Tiwari to "take Rinkiya away". Reeti is facing online backlash for her alleged behavior.
